method: Manual visual pixel-landmark estimates on the five 851x1265 RGBA PNGs. Body height is topmost visible plastic rim to lowest physical base, excluding cream. Rim width is the outer visible horizontal rim span. Base width is the widest visible lower molded section. Ratios describe projected image geometry, not physical dimensions. Coordinate uncertainty is approximately 10 pixels per landmark; clear edges and highlights make exact boundaries ambiguous. No geometric rectification was applied.
user_source_intent: USER-CONFIRMED: these inputs all use the same cup.
interpretation: OBSERVED: projected body-height/rim-width estimates span about 1.457 to 1.479 and base-width/rim-width about 0.705 to 0.740. This supports a visibly tighter source family than the prior mixed inputs, but is not proof of exact physical equality or of generated-output causality.
